_meta.definition: Rule-15 rulings on the EPS YoY input (Watchlist col 18). value=null means a documented blank; a number means an ex-item YoY % (arithmetic stated in basis) that replaces the yfinance GAAP figure. A ruling applies only while quarter_end matches the name's most recent reported quarter (yfinance mostRecentQuarter); after the next print it is STALE and refresh_objective_inputs.py withholds the cell and re-raises it. Human-written; the script never edits this file.
_meta.refresh_rule: Add/replace an entry in the same session that appends the Rating Audit row (audit_row points at it). Remove nothing: a superseded entry is replaced by the new quarter's ruling.

CIEN.basis: OPERATING, not one-time — ruling CONFIRMS the GAAP figure rather than blanking it. GAAP net income $266.418M vs $50.308M (+429.6%); income from operations alone $301.179M vs $73.535M = +309.6% on revenue +37.0%, so the change is operating-leverage-dominated off a depressed PY base (rule 15: 'a big operational number off a small base stays'). Non-operating delta is recurring, not a gain: interest expense $5.803M vs $22.806M and interest income $22.388M vs $15.090M, both from the completed refinancing and larger cash balance. The only disclosed one-time item is a $7.143M loss on debt extinguishment, which REDUCES the current-period figure — so +429.6% is conservative, not inflated.
CIEN.source: 8-K Item 2.02 Ex-99.1 filed 2026-09-03, Condensed Consolidated Statements of Operations, quarter ended 2026-08-01 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/936395/000162828026060245/ex9912026q3earningspressre.htm)
CIEN.audit_row: Rating Audit 2026-09-08 EPS YoY (objective) — earnings sentinel

AMZN.basis: GAAP net income $20,685M vs $21,187M (-2.4%) is dominated by Q3 2025 Anthropic gains: other income (expense), net $10,186M a year ago vs -$703M now. Pretax income excluding other income (expense), net: $27,572M vs $17,984M = +53.3% (pretax proxy, SHOP standard); operating income +61.2%.
AMZN.source: 8-K Ex-99.1 filed 2026-10-29 (acc. 0001018724-26-000038); 10-Q filed 2026-10-30, Statements of Operations + Note Other Income (Expense), Net (acc. 0001018724-26-000040)

GMED.basis: Ruling confirms the GAAP figure: net income $141.171M vs $118.966M (+18.7%; diluted EPS $1.04 vs $0.88). Most of the rise is the litigation provision in SG&A falling ($3.665M vs $28.261M); GMED books such provisions every year in uneven amounts, so it is treated as recurring operating cost, not a rule-15 one-off. Ex-litigation alternative +5.3% (non-GAAP EPS +4.4%) flagged for Dom.

WDC.basis: Non-GAAP EPS $4.64 vs $1.78 (+161%). GAAP $4.63 vs $3.07 (+50.5%) understates growth: the prior-year quarter included a $611M Sandisk retained-interest gain, and the stake was fully disposed by 2026-07-03, so this quarter has no such gain. Prior-year quarter had 14 weeks.

GOOGL.basis: Diluted EPS $9.11 vs $2.31 (+294%); equity-securities gain $99,031M is 71% of pre-tax income $138,753M

MU.basis: Operational memory super-cycle, no one-off: FY2026 revenue $133,188M vs $37,378M, operating income $99,340M (75% of revenue) vs $9,770M, net income $84,969M vs $8,539M - net income is below operating income, so nothing non-operating inflates it. Fiscal Q4 (q/e 2026-09-03) GAAP YoY +1077.8% per yfinance earningsQuarterlyGrowth; quarterly statements in yfinance still lag at 2026-05-31, so the Q4 quarter itself was not decomposed.
MU.source: 10-K FY2026 (filed 2026-10-09, acc. 0000723125-26-000023) consolidated statements of operations; yfinance 2026-10-11

VST.basis: Offsetting items, not one-off-dominated - ruling CONFIRMS the GAAP figure. GAAP net income $1,140M vs $652M (+74.8%). Unrealized hedge gains $559M vs $184M are offset in the same quarter by a $269M Moss Landing impairment, a $60M NDT loss (vs a $62M gain), $65M insurance income and $24M swap gains; removing all items from both years gives pretax $1,177M vs $625M (net income +88.4%), so GAAP understates rather than inflates growth. Hedge-only ex-MTM (+46.6% EPS) is one-sided.
VST.source: 10-Q q/e 2026-09-30 (filed 2026-11-09, acc. 0001692819-26-000025) Stmt of Ops + Adjusted EBITDA reconciliations + derivative note; 8-K Ex-99.1 filed 2026-11-06 (acc. 0001692819-26-000023)

Ex-items pretax $30.2M vs $22.4M; per diluted share at a uniform rate on 42.7M vs 36.0M shares: $0.708 vs $0.623 = +13.7%. Amortization kept in. Net-income basis would be +34.8%.

CEG.basis: Operational with non-operating items largely cancelling - ruling CONFIRMS the GAAP figure. Adjusted operating earnings $1,792M vs $952M (+88.2%); operating income $2,492M vs $1,086M with Calpine added. Per-share +74.7% on 13% more shares.
CEG.source: 10-Q q/e 2026-09-30 (filed 2026-11-09, acc. 0001868275-26-000119) Stmt of Ops; 8-K Ex-99.1 filed 2026-11-09 (acc. 0001868275-26-000116) Adjusted Operating Earnings reconciliation
